# `em query meta`

- **Usage:** `em query meta [--format <FORMAT>] <ATOM>…`

Display package metadata (maintainer, homepage, etc.)

## Arguments
- **`<ATOM>…`** — Atom(s) whose metadata to display

## Flags
- **`--format <FORMAT>`**

  **Choices:** `pretty`, `json`

  **Default:** `pretty`
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Output Formats

- **`pretty`** (default) — Human-readable text

  **Framing:** `text`
- **`json`** — Machine-parsable JSON

  **Framing:** `json`
